Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

1. Scope — Covers the dimensions and material for swing clamps used the hold work pieces in 
place when they are being machined.

IS : 5250 - 1984 

3. Designation — A swing clamp having d = 11 mm and / = 70 mm shall be designated as: 

Swing Clamp 11 x 70 IS : 5250 

4. Material — Steel suitably hardened and tempered to a tensile strength of 750 to 850 N/mm 2 . 

5. Finish — The swing clamps shall be free from cracks, burrs, pits and other defects. These shall 
also be free from sharp corners. 

6. Preservation and Packing 

6.1 A suitable anti-corrosive surface treatment shall be given to swing clamps. 

6.2 The swing clamps shall be packed in accordance with best trade practice. 

7. Marking 

7.1 The swing clamps shall be marked at an appropriate place with the designation and manufacturer's 
name or trade-mark. 

7.2 ISI Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 



EXPL A N A TORY NOTE 

This standard was first published in 1969. The committee responsible for formulation of this 
standard decided to revise it on the basis of experience gained over so many years and to keep it in 
line with other standards on clamps. The latter are also being revised in respect to material, roughness 
values, tolerance and rationalization of sizes. 

In the present revision, the figure under Table 1 has been modified to suit the current practice, 
and two more sizes of clamps to suit screw sizes M24 and M30 have been included. Dimensions *W 
for swing clamps for screw sizes M12 and M20 have been modified. 



Printed at Arcee Press, New Delhi. India
